name: Himadri Speciality Chemical Ltd.
about: Himadri Speciality Chemical Limited manufactures and sells carbon materials and chemicals in India and internationally. The company operates through Carbon Materials and Chemicals and Power segments. It offers anode materials, LFP cathodes, and recycling materials. The company also provides SDS, TDS, ASTM, lithium mining and refining, and carbon black; tyre, MRG, plastics, ink, and coatings; refined naphthalene, coal tar pitch, specialty oils, clean energy, and anti-corrosion products. It serves lithium-ion batteries, paints, plastics, tyres, technical rubber goods, aluminium, graphite electrodes, agrochemicals, defence, and construction chemicals industries. It also engages in industrial chemicals trading and petrochemicals trading. Himadri Speciality Chemical Limited was formerly known as Himadri Chemicals & Industries Limited and changed its name to Himadri Speciality Chemical Limited

buffett.name: Each ₹1 retained created ≥ ₹1 of market value

verdict.label: Around fair value
reasons: Price implies ~23% a year profit growth for 10 years, versus ~19% that history and analysts support (reverse DCF at 10.8% cost of equity).
PE of 33 is near the bottom of its range over the last 3 years (median 50), though that is a short history to judge by.
Since 2023, the price gain has been earned: earnings grew 49% a year while PE moved 30 → 33.
